nodes.description: Owner address of the contract, set in the Ownable constructor from msg.sender and used by the onlyOwner access control checks.
Pausable flag controlling the whenNotPaused/whenPaused modifiers on attack, revive, pause and unpause.
Fee in wei required to start a dungeon run; refunded half at checkpoint/breakeven levels and partially converted to jackpot.
Pool holding the collected entrance fees; decremented by rewards and by addToJackpot calculations.
Accumulated jackpot, increased by revive fees and unrefunded entrance fees, decreased when the jackpot level is defeated.
Mapping from hero ID to its current Monster struct (creation time, level, initial/current health).
Mapping from hero ID to the hero's remaining health during a dungeon run.
Mapping from hero ID to the already refunded portion of the entrance fee; used to compute the unrefunded amount added to the jackpot.
Private pseudo-random seed mutated by keccak256 of block variables inside _getRandomNumber.
Reference to the external EDCoreInterface contract used for hero/game data queries; owner-settable via setEdCoreContract.
Fee in wei required to reset a dungeon run for a hero; goes directly into the jackpot.
External payable entry point of a dungeon run; validates hero ownership, collects entrance fee, refunds excess ether to msg.sender and calls _attack.
External payable function that resets a hero's dungeon run, adds reviveFee to the jackpot and deletes run mappings.
Internal attack logic computing hero/monster damage, updating health and monster state, paying rewards to msg.sender and emitting LogAttack.
Private PRNG returning _seed % _upper, seeded from block.blockhash, block.coinbase and block.difficulty (predictable randomness).
onlyOwner function calling selfdestruct(owner), destroying the contract and sending all balance to the owner.
onlyOwner function calling selfdestruct(_recipient), destroying the contract and sending all balance to an arbitrary address.
onlyOwner function that sets paused = true, blocking attack/revive.
onlyOwner function that sets paused = false, re-enabling attack/revive.
onlyOwner function transferring contract ownership to newOwner after a non-zero address check.
onlyOwner setter for the entranceFee state variable.
onlyOwner setter for the reviveFee state variable.
onlyOwner setter replacing the edCoreContract interface address.
External view function reading hero/monster state from storage and from edCoreContract, using now to determine the game state.
External view function returning all game settings constants and state variables in a single call.
Payable constructor of DungeonRunCore.
Modifier using inline assembly extcodesize to reject callers that are contracts (bypassable from a constructor).
Untrusted caller address used for ownership checks, fee refunds via transfer and event emission.
Untrusted block timestamp (now) driving monster flee timing, game state and rewards logic.
selfdestruct(owner) in destroy(): irreversible destruction sending the balance to the owner address.
selfdestruct(_recipient) in destroyAndSend(): sends the entire balance to an arbitrary owner-supplied address and kills the contract.
msg.sender.transfer() calls inside attack() for refunding excess msg.value and unused fees (external call / reentrancy surface).
msg.sender.transfer() inside revive() refunding the excess revive fee (external call / reentrancy surface).
msg.sender.transfer(rewards) inside _attack(), paying checkpoint/breakeven/jackpot rewards before state is fully settled.
keccak256(_seed, block.blockhash(block.number - 1), block.coinbase, block.difficulty) in _getRandomNumber: miner-influenceable, predictable PRNG.
entranceFeePool -= addToJackpot where addToJackpot = entranceFee - heroIdToRefundedFee[...]: unsigned subtraction that can underflow and mis-account the pool.
Hero ID supplied by the caller to attack(); used for ownership checks and mapping lookups.
Local flag in attack() indicating that the run terminated because the monster fled.
Local copy of the hero's current health in attack(), passed into the internal _attack call.
Local unrefunded entrance fee amount moved from entranceFeePool to jackpot when a run ends in attack().
Hero ID supplied by the caller to revive(); used to delete run state mappings.
Hero ID passed from attack() into the internal _attack() function.
Hero gene value passed into _attack() and forwarded to edCoreContract.getHeroPower.
Hero strength passed into _attack() and used in the damage-by-hero formula.
Hero current health passed into _attack() and compared against damageByMonster.
Damage dealt by the hero, computed from strength, heroPower, gas price and the PRNG, then subtracted from monster health.
Damage dealt by the monster (flee damage or PRNG-based counterattack) subtracted from hero health.
Reward amount (half entrance fee or half jackpot) transferred to msg.sender when a boss level is defeated.
Local unrefunded entrance fee amount moved to the jackpot when the hero is defeated inside _attack().
Upper bound parameter of _getRandomNumber(); result is _seed % _upper.
New owner address supplied to transferOwnership(); becomes the owner state variable.
Recipient address supplied to destroyAndSend() and passed directly to selfdestruct.
New EDCoreInterface address supplied to setEdCoreContract() and written to edCoreContract.
New entrance fee value supplied to setEntranceFee() and written to entranceFee.
New revive fee value supplied to setReviveFee() and written to reviveFee.
Hero ID supplied to getRunDetails(); used to read hero/monster state and query edCoreContract.
Local output of getRunDetails() representing the hero's health for the current game state.
Local output of getRunDetails() encoding NotStarted/NewMonster/Active/RunEnded state.

edges.reason: The Ownable constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner, which requires msg.sender == owner.
destroy is protected by onlyOwner; any other msg.sender reverts.
destroyAndSend is protected by onlyOwner; any other msg.sender reverts.
pause is callable only by the owner (onlyOwner modifier).
unpause is callable only by the owner (onlyOwner modifier).
setEntranceFee is restricted to the owner; only msg.sender == owner passes.
setReviveFee is restricted to the owner; only msg.sender == owner passes.
setEdCoreContract is restricted to the owner and can repoint the external core contract.
attack reads msg.sender and requires it to equal the hero owner returned by edCoreContract.
revive uses msg.sender as the refund recipient for excess msg.value.
onlyHumanAddress reads msg.sender and applies extcodesize, a contract-caller check that is bypassable from a constructor.
The onlyHumanAddress modifier gates attack and reverts when the caller has code size > 0.
attack compares now against monster.creationTime + monsterFleeTime to decide whether the run ended.
getRunDetails derives the game state purely from block.timestamp comparisons against monster timers.
_attack uses now to decide flee damage and whether to spawn the next level monster.
attack calls the internal _attack function after all preconditions pass.
_attack calls _getRandomNumber to compute hero and monster damage.
_getRandomNumber recomputes and stores the new _seed value.
_getRandomNumber reads the previous _seed when deriving the next random number.
The PRNG is seeded with block.blockhash, block.coinbase and block.difficulty, all influenceable by miners.
destroy executes selfdestruct(owner), permanently killing the contract.
destroyAndSend executes selfdestruct(_recipient) with a caller-supplied address.
The owner state variable is the beneficiary passed to selfdestruct inside destroy.
The _recipient parameter flows directly into selfdestruct in destroyAndSend.
attack performs msg.sender.transfer() for fee refunds, an external call made while the run state is being updated.
revive performs msg.sender.transfer() after crediting the jackpot but before finishing state cleanup.
_attack performs msg.sender.transfer(rewards), an external call reachable during state mutation of the run.
msg.sender is the recipient of the refund transfers in attack, enabling callback attempts on the caller.
msg.sender is the recipient of the excess revive fee transfer in revive.
msg.sender is the recipient of the reward transfer in _attack.
attack computes addToJackpot = entranceFee - heroIdToRefundedFee and then performs entranceFeePool -= addToJackpot.
_attack repeats the same unsigned subtraction and entranceFeePool decrement when the hero is defeated.
entranceFeePool is decremented by addToJackpot, which can underflow and corrupt the pool accounting.
entranceFee is the minuend used to derive addToJackpot in the subtraction.
jackpot is credited with the same addToJackpot amount moved out of the pool.
heroIdToRefundedFee is subtracted from entranceFee to compute addToJackpot.
attack calls the external EDCoreInterface for hero details and hero power, an external contract callback.
_attack calls edCoreContract.getHeroPower for the hero power used in the damage formula.
getRunDetails calls edCoreContract.getHeroDetails and getHeroPower to build the run view.
setEdCoreContract changes the edCoreContract address, controlling which external code the contract calls.
The owner-supplied _newEdCoreContract address is written into edCoreContract.
setEntranceFee is an owner-only setter that mutates the entranceFee used for run payments.
_newEntranceFee flows into the entranceFee state variable.
setReviveFee is an owner-only setter that mutates the revive fee.
_newReviveFee flows into the reviveFee state variable.
pause sets the paused flag to true.
unpause sets the paused flag to false.
attack is guarded by whenNotPaused, which reads the paused state variable.
revive is guarded by whenNotPaused, which reads the paused state variable.
transferOwnership reassigns the owner state variable to the new address.
newOwner becomes the new owner, granting full privileged access.
attack creates a level 1 Monster in heroIdToMonster when the run starts.
_attack mutates monster health and spawns the next level monster in heroIdToMonster.
attack initializes heroIdToHealth with the hero's initial health.
_attack reduces or zeroes heroIdToHealth based on monster damage.
revive deletes the hero's monster entry from heroIdToMonster.
revive deletes the hero's health entry from heroIdToHealth.
revive deletes the hero's refunded fee entry from heroIdToRefundedFee.
_attack accumulates checkpoint/breakeven refunds and jackpot contributions in heroIdToRefundedFee.
attack updates heroIdToRefundedFee when moving the unrefunded fee into the jackpot.
The _heroId parameter drives ownership verification and monster/health lookups inside attack.
The _heroId parameter selects which hero mapping entries revive deletes.
_heroId indexes heroIdToMonster and heroIdToHealth inside _attack.
_genes is forwarded to edCoreContract.getHeroPower inside _attack.
_heroStrength feeds the damageByHero computation in _attack.
_heroCurrentHealth is compared against damageByMonster in _attack.
_upper bounds the returned pseudo-random value via modulo.
newOwner is validated and written to the owner state variable in transferOwnership.
_recipient is consumed by destroyAndSend before being passed to selfdestruct.
_newEdCoreContract is consumed by setEdCoreContract before being cast and stored.
_newEntranceFee is consumed by setEntranceFee before being stored.
_newReviveFee is consumed by setReviveFee before being stored.
_heroId is used by getRunDetails to query hero details and read run mappings.
heroCurrentHealth from attack is passed as _heroCurrentHealth into _attack.
attack's addToJackpot local is subtracted from entranceFeePool, risking underflow.
_attack's addToJackpot local is subtracted from entranceFeePool, risking underflow.
damageByHero determines whether the monster is defeated and therefore whether rewards are transferred.
damageByMonster is subtracted from heroIdToHealth, potentially zeroing the run.
rewards is the amount paid out via msg.sender.transfer inside _attack.
The dungeonRunEnded flag in attack determines whether the internal _attack call is skipped.
_heroHealth is the computed health output of getRunDetails.
_gameState is the computed state output of getRunDetails.

normalization_plan.reason: attack._heroId is a transient parameter used only inside attack and should collapse into the attack function node.
attack.dungeonRunEnded is a local control flag scoped to attack and merges into the attack function node.
attack.heroCurrentHealth is a local copy passed directly into _attack and merges into the _attack function node.
attack.addToJackpot exists only to feed the entranceFeePool subtraction unsafe operation.
revive._heroId is a transient parameter used only inside revive and merges into the revive function node.
_attack._heroId is an internal parameter indexing state inside _attack and merges into the _attack function node.
_attack._genes is an internal parameter used for hero power inside _attack and merges into the _attack function node.
_attack._heroStrength is an internal parameter used in the damage formula inside _attack.
_attack._heroCurrentHealth is an internal parameter compared to damage inside _attack.
_attack.damageByHero is a local computed value used only within _attack and merges into the _attack function node.
_attack.damageByMonster is a local computed value used only within _attack and merges into the _attack function node.
_attack.rewards exists solely as the amount forwarded by the msg.sender.transfer external call.
_attack.addToJackpot exists solely to feed the entranceFeePool subtraction unsafe operation.
_getRandomNumber._upper is a transient bounds parameter of the PRNG helper function.
transferOwnership.newOwner is a transient parameter written into the owner state variable by transferOwnership.
destroyAndSend._recipient flows directly into the selfdestruct unsafe operation, so it merges there.
setEdCoreContract._newEdCoreContract is a transient parameter consumed by setEdCoreContract.
setEntranceFee._newEntranceFee is a transient parameter consumed by setEntranceFee.
setReviveFee._newReviveFee is a transient parameter consumed by setReviveFee.
getRunDetails._heroId is a transient parameter used only inside the getRunDetails view function.
getRunDetails._heroHealth is a local output variable scoped to getRunDetails and merges into that function.
getRunDetails._gameState is a local output variable scoped to getRunDetails and merges into that function.
